title: Unit-multiplicity tangent plane implies μ(B̄_ρ(x))/ρⁿ → ω_n (parent Step 3)
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, let μ be a Borel measure on ℝ^N, x ∈ ℝ^N and P ⊆ ℝ^N a linear subspace. Assume μ(B̄_δ(x)) < ∞ for some δ > 0, and HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P 1: dim P = n and (rⁿ)⁻¹∫ f(η_{x,r}(y)) dμ(y) → ∫_P f dHⁿ as r ↓ 0 for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^N, ℝ), where η_{x,r}(y) = r⁻¹(y − x) and Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Then μ(B̄_ρ(x))/ρⁿ → ω_n := Lⁿ(B_1(0)) in [0, ∞] as ρ ↓ 0, the quotient being taken in [0, ∞] with denominator ofReal(ρⁿ).
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (x : Rn N) (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), (∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ μ (Metric.closedBall x δ) < ∞) → HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x P 1 → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ μ (Metric.closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn n) 1)))
